build_selection: Pinned by robotservice master; detached checkout
source_notes: Rebuild all four DDS and UniUbi runtime bundles from robotservice master and its pinned Build, using SDK main. SDK main was already the pinned Sdk/cpp commit. No business-source or public-header patches were applied. The original and English-message-rewritten SDK commits have identical trees. DDS uses isolated minimal toolchains and source-tree headers; its rebuilt library replaces the dependency in the isolated Build before building robotMotionSdk, mediaBus, ubase, udbus and uutils. All other packaged libraries retain the stated baseline.

cyclonedds.toolchain_scope: Compiler, architecture flags and sysroot only; no Build installed-header include directories.

validation.public_headers: All delivered headers match SDK main used to build the runtimes. Build and public SDK atomic Delegate headers are identical.
validation.abi: Breaking struct-layout change relative to Cyvet-V1.00.002 (SDK deca496) and earlier: MotionOdometry is 48 bytes (was 40), SensorObserved is 88 bytes (was 80). Rebuild C++ applications and Python native extensions against these headers and matched libraries. No removed strong dynamic exports or new GLIBC/GLIBCXX version requirements were found across the six rebuilt library families; those checks do not establish binary compatibility for the changed structs.

sensor_observation_regression.guarded_cache_copy: Passed with actual rebuilt x86_64 SDK object files: old fields retained, uint64 tail above 2^48 copied, surrounding canaries intact.
sensor_observation_regression.scope: Synthetic DDS frame injection and cached reads, without device connection. The pre-existing test was copied to the evidence directory with the expected ABI size changed to 88 and additional tail/canary assertions; source files were not modified.

validation.step_count: Current master RemoteHighLevelObsImpl::onSensorFrame does not assign stepCnt, and the DDS IDL has no step-count field. This rebuild matches the 48/88-byte C++ ABI but does not establish populated step-count observations. Python and ROS 2 step-count exposure is unchanged.
validation.python_loaded_runtime: The rebuilt CPython 3.10 x86_64 native extension passed its tests; /proc/self/maps verified robotMotionSdk, mediaBus, ubase, udbus, uutils and ddsc loaded from this staged runtime bundle (uutils was checked separately with libubase loaded globally). This was isolated validation, not a Python package release.
validation.uutils_standalone: Both the baseline and rebuilt x86_64 libuutils have the same 26 unresolved symbols when loaded alone; explicit loading succeeds after libubase is loaded globally. This pre-existing dependency behavior is unchanged. robotMotionSdk and its examples do not require a separately loaded uutils.
validation.dds_loopback: x86_64 and i386 domain/participant creation and deletion passed using explicit loopback peers; no robot traffic.
validation.arm_runtime: All public examples cross-linked for aarch64 and aarch64_host. Target-device loading, RPC and media were not tested.
validation.dds_regressions: Prior direct-discovery and locator suites were not rerun for this delivery; previous counts are not carried forward.
validation.ros2: Not rebuilt or retested for this delivery.
validation.physical_robot: No firmware deployment, robot connection, motion or hardware validation.
